episodes.title: Crime Chats LIVE | The Cult in Plain Sight: The Sullivanians
episodes.description:
Made with Restream. Livestream on 30+ platforms at once via https://restream.io

What happens when a group of people searching for love, belonging, and community find themselves caught up in something much darker? 

🎙️This week on Crime Chats, we're diving into The Sullivanians, a controversial New York City therapy cult that blurred the lines between psychology, power, sex, and control. Facts first, hot takes later. 👀

🎃 Grab your kids' Halloween candy (we know you still have some stashed somewhere!), and join Crime Chats for a case that will definitely spark conversation -- maybe even a little controversy...!

🎙️ Crime Chats: Facts first, hot takes later.

⚠️ Content warning: This episode discusses sexual exploitation and other possibly triggering content. Listener discretion is advised.
